per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains separate from final acceptance; it is material_extracted_with_gaps because exact Fig. 4 bar values are not tabulated, but XML/PDF/OA/database materials are sufficient for obtainable-only source-reviewed analysis.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural files exist and gates are rerun after repair; validator success alone is not used as acceptance evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.activity_toxicity: Worker-2 converted the empty activity layer into source-located qualitative Fig. 4 E. coli/S. aureus survival-comparison rows plus the exact reported hemolysis threshold; no database-only assay row is promoted as primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.database_record_verification: Worker-4 preserved APD6 sequence strings with database provenance, source-verified only citation links, and retained I4R/S15R/A32K qualitative activity mismatches as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.mechanism_ontology: Worker-6 records phenotypic antibacterial activity, structure-activity interpretation, low hemolysis, and an explicit mechanism gap without promoting background membrane/DNA mechanisms to direct evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The previous blocking issue was lack of source-reviewed worker-6 adjudication and empty activity rows; these have been repaired. Remaining caveats are explicit, nonblocking cautions rather than open rework targets.

caution_findings.finding: Fig. 4 supports qualitative survival-percentage comparisons and assay conditions, but no source table gives exact bar values; exact values were not digitized or fabricated.
Primary source supports mutation labels and mature pBD2 context; APD6 exact sequence strings are preserved as database-provenance records.
APD6 linked comments for I4R/S15R/A32K are broader or conflicting relative to primary prose and are not smoothed into source_verified claims.
The article provides phenotypic and structure-activity interpretation but no direct mechanism assay for the mutant series.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 source-reviewed re-repair closed rwk-complete-test-0001: activity rows are source-located, APD6 conflicts are preserved, direct mechanism is not overclaimed, and strict semantic/publication gates pass with cautions.
